name: GitHub Actions
author: Enplace
summary: A repo's GitHub Actions builds: each run and each platform's job, a Run button, and a bug for agents when one fails.
description: Goes on a project beside the GitHub plugin and uses its repo and token. It shows the latest runs of a workflow with each of its jobs, so a build that makes several platforms (iOS, Android, Mac, PC) shows how each one went, and Run starts the workflow on a branch. Switch it on for a product too and that product shows only the job that builds it, matched by name (the iOS job for an iPhone app) or picked in its settings; it reads the project's runs, so it costs nothing extra. When a job fails it files a bug on that job's product with the failing step and its errors for an agent to fix, one per workflow, job and branch, and re-runs the failed jobs once the bug is done. On an app product it can make the app's builds: pick it in Builds come from and Enplace starts the workflow when TestFlight asks for a build. It shares its runs in the same shape any CI plugin does. With instant updates on, GitHub tells Enplace the moment a run starts or ends; otherwise it checks every 30 minutes.

settings.name: Workflow
settings.help: The workflow this follows and Run starts, like Build. Blank follows every workflow, and Run starts the one that ran last.

settings.name: Branch
settings.help: The branch Run starts it on, like main or release/0.8.0. Blank uses the GitHub plugin's branch, else the repo's default.

settings.name: Job for this product
settings.help: On a product: the job that builds it, from the workflow's latest run. Blank matches it by name: iOS for an iPhone app, Android, Mac, or Windows for PC and Steam.

settings.name: When a build fails
settings.help: File a bug for agents adds a high-priority bug on the failed job's product, with the failing step and its errors, handed to agents without asking: one per workflow, job and branch, and a job that fails again adds a note to it. Once the bug is done, Enplace re-runs the failed jobs. Ask me first sends each new bug to Approvals. Do nothing only shows the failure here.

settings.name: GitHub token
settings.help: The GitHub plugin's token: set it once, there or here. Give it Actions: read to follow builds, and Actions: read and write to start and re-run them.

tools.name: get_actions_runs
tools.description: A project's or product's GitHub Actions: its workflows and latest runs (number, workflow, branch, commit, status: queued, running, passed, failed or cancelled) with each run's jobs and the step a failed job stopped at.
